comments.comment: This block resolves the newest `cross` tag from a live GitHub repository and then pipes another remote installer (`https://japaric.github.io/trust/install.sh`) into `sh` with that mutable tag. That means the script executes third-party code at install time without pinning or integrity verification, so a compromised release, repo, or hosting path could inject arbitrary commands into the build host.

This line executes a network-fetched shell script from `https://sh.rustup.rs` directly through `sh` during setup. If that endpoint, TLS path, or fetched content is compromised, the install step can run arbitrary code in the CI environment before the build starts, which is a classic supply-chain execution risk.
